title: The Founder's Creditor
text: A man in grave-clothes waits in the hall with a ledger. On the last page, in your founder's own hand, is a debt: payable this Year, in Gold or in blood, at the creditor's choosing. He has chosen to let you choose.

options.label: Pay the founder's debt in Gold, and keep the House's blood its own.

outcomes.text: He counts every coin twice, bows, and leaves no footprints in the snow.

options.label: Pay it in blood, as the founder perhaps intended.

outcomes.text: The eldest of the House opens a vein over the ledger. The page drinks, and is clean.
The page drinks too deeply. The eldest is a long time recovering, and never warm again.

options.label: Refuse him, and burn the ledger. The dead do not collect.

outcomes.text: The ledger burns green. He smiles, and goes.
The ledger burns green. Over the next weeks, things the House owns begin to go missing, one by one: a horse, a ring, a wing of the Seat.
